story.title: Serbia just elected the world's brainiest parliament

draft:
A parliament where the average IQ outpaces most tech teams.

Serbia’s new legislature is now populated by scientists, engineers, and academics whose combined test scores would rank them among the world’s smartest cohorts. The election was driven by a public push for evidence‑based decision‑making, and the result is a body that can read a research paper as easily as a bill.

I’m intrigued but cautious. High cognitive ability doesn’t automatically solve political gridlock or guarantee policies that serve everyone. The real test will be whether this expertise translates into data‑driven legislation without slipping into technocratic elitism.

Can a brainy parliament turn raw intellect into smarter, more inclusive policies?

#AI #Governance #Serbia #TechPolicy #DataDriven
